Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog: Fix a false conflict warning caused by disabled mods — Penumbra remembers a mod's last group selection even while it's off, so a disabled mod's stale selection was still being counted as an active claimant against whatever's actually enabled.
